# Template: payoff_matrix
A 2x2 game-theory payoff matrix: each cell shows both players' payoffs as "row, col", with best-response payoffs underlined per column (the row player's) and per row (the column player's) — the classic underlining method — and, by default, the pure-strategy Nash equilibrium cell(s) shaded, computed by checking that both payoffs are mutual best responses. Choose this scene for ANY request about game theory, a payoff matrix, the prisoner's dilemma, Nash equilibrium, a dominant strategy, best response, or any two-player simultaneous-move game.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "row_player": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Name of the row player (default \"Player 1\")."
  },
  "col_player": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Name of the column player (default \"Player 2\")."
  },
  "row_strategies": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": "string"
   },
   "minItems": 2,
   "maxItems": 2,
   "description": "The row player's two strategy names, top row first."
  },
  "col_strategies": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": "string"
   },
   "minItems": 2,
   "maxItems": 2,
   "description": "The column player's two strategy names, left column first."
  },
  "payoffs": {
   "type": "array",
   "minItems": 2,
   "maxItems": 2,
   "items": {
    "type": "array",
    "minItems": 2,
    "maxItems": 2,
    "items": {
     "type": "array",
     "minItems": 2,
     "maxItems": 2,
     "items": {
      "type": "number"
     }
    }
   },
   "description": "Row-major 2x2 payoffs: payoffs[row][col] = [row player's payoff, column player's payoff]."
  },
  "highlight_equilibrium": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Shade the pure-strategy Nash equilibrium cell(s), computed by a best-response check (default true)."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- grid: the 2x2 grid lines
- cell_0_0 / cell_0_1 / cell_1_0 / cell_1_1: each cell (a group holding its payoff text and any best-response underline strokes)
- nash_<r>_<c>: shaded region behind a pure-strategy Nash equilibrium cell, present only for such cells when highlight_equilibrium
- row_label_0 / row_label_1: the row strategy names
- col_label_0 / col_label_1: the column strategy names
- row_player_label / col_player_label: the two players' names
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw the prisoner's dilemma payoff matrix and highlight the Nash equilibrium." → params: {"row_player":"Suspect A","col_player":"Suspect B","row_strategies":["Cooperate","Defect"],"col_strategies":["Cooperate","Defect"],"payoffs":[[[3,3],[0,5]],[[5,0],[1,1]]],"title":"Prisoner's Dilemma"}
Request: "Draw a stag hunt game and show both Nash equilibria." → params: {"row_player":"Hunter 1","col_player":"Hunter 2","row_strategies":["Stag","Hare"],"col_strategies":["Stag","Hare"],"payoffs":[[[4,4],[0,3]],[[3,0],[2,2]]],"title":"Stag Hunt"}

In YAML: `template: payoff_matrix` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
